Direction: A single abstract arch / doorway cut into a solid terracotta square, subtly implying the letter A. Mediterranean whitewashed architecture distilled into one powerful negative-space mark. Beneath, a sophisticated editorial serif wordmark. No ornamental Moorish illustration.
